title: P0: add session-scoped X-Agent Gateway client after private API is available
description: Implement the public SDK HTTP client only after the private Commerce Gateway publishes its authenticated contract: createXAgentClient with end-user session token, chat, balance, usage, receipt status/recovery and top-up checkout calls. It must never expose project secrets, reserves, settlement internals, provider keys, or wallet keys.

title: P1: implement protocol-specific x402 and MPP adapters
description: Build production protocol adapters on top of the safe paid-call loop: validate x402/MPP offers, obtain gateway credentials, normalize receipts and delivery statuses, persist idempotency/reconciliation facts, and run a real X-Agent MCP capability end-to-end. This remains after the SDK-only 402 loop.

title: P0: select and publish an OSI license for the open X-Agent SDK
description: The user requires this repository to be open-source SDK only, but package.json currently states UNLICENSED and no LICENSE file exists. Choose an approved license (for example Apache-2.0 or MIT), add the legal file and SPDX metadata, and document that the hosted Commerce Gateway remains closed source. Requires legal/owner approval before changing licensing.

title: P1: add LangChain and OpenAI SDK adapters
description: Provide thin adapters that map LangChain and OpenAI-compatible calls to the framework-neutral X-Agent commerce runtime without exposing billing or wallet internals to application code.

title: P0: publish Chinese README and SDK integration guide
description: Rewrite the public README and add a Chinese SDK developer guide with accurate current capabilities, quick starts, 402 guidance, X-Agent runtime boundary, security requirements, and closed Gateway roadmap. Do not claim unfinished hosted billing capabilities.
close_reason: Rewrote Chinese README and published Chinese SDK integration guide plus phased development plan; verified VitePress build and formatting.

title: P1: persist payment ledger and atomic budget reservations
description: Move Intent, Decision, Attempt, Receipt, Delivery, Acceptance and budget reservations from process-local SDK state into durable storage with atomic multi-agent/multi-instance limits, reconciliation, and recovery for paid-but-undelivered calls.

title: P0: build hosted commerce gateway API contract
description: Specify and implement the server-side API that backs X-Agent runtime: authenticated tenant/project/user context, atomic durable reserves/settles/releases, provider routing, top-up/credit ledger, receipt retrieval, and webhooks. Requires threat model, OpenAPI 3.1, persistent storage, authz, rate limits, observability and live-payment rollout.

title: P0: implement safe HTTP 402 paid-call loop
description: Implement the SDK-level P0 paid-call loop: parse a 402 response into a bounded challenge, request a credential through a caller-owned policy/signing callback, retry exactly once with the same idempotency key, and refuse unsafe/non-replayable requests. Preserve dry-run/no-key ownership; add unit tests, docs, ADR, and update the public API.
close_reason: Implemented and verified safe HTTP 402 paid-call loop with one controlled retry, replay/redirect guardrails, bounded challenge handling, docs, ADR, and tests.

title: P0: define LangChain-style commerce runtime contract
description: Define and implement a framework-neutral xagent runtime vertical slice: user/project/task context, model-provider port, two-phase reserve/settle billing port, exact usage record, bounded SDK idempotency, in-memory reference adapter, docs, ADR, and tests. Non-goal: claim hosted wallet, persistent ledger, real top-up, or live model proxy without a backend contract.
notes: Implemented reference runtime contract; awaiting final independent re-review before close.
close_reason: Implemented and independently reviewed the open X-Agent reference runtime: reserve/invoke/settle contract, idempotency, exact usage receipts, project-isolated in-memory test adapter, recovery semantics, docs and ADR. Production Gateway remains tracked separately.
